full_text: SB 1448 PROBATION DISCLOSURE TO PATIENTS. Form dated 05/11/2023. Issued by Inland Psychiatric Medical Group Inc. Dr. Hozair M Syed, M.D. has been placed on probation by the Medical Board of California for a period of five years, effective May 19, 2023. Expected probation end date is May 18, 2028. Practice restrictions include: Not able to supervise any Nurse Practitioner. Directs patients to contact the Medical Board of California at 2005 Evergreen Street, Suite 1200, Sacramento, CA 95815, phone (800) 633-2322, or search license details on search.dca.ca.gov.
